name: Bruno
description: Soft-eyed and gentle. Brings you a toy before you have even sat down. Fully vaccinated and good with children.

name: Luna
description: Long white coat, calm manner. Sleeps wherever the sun lands and tolerates brushing like a queen.

name: Max
description: Loyal and quick to learn. Knows sit, stay and heel. Needs an active family with some outdoor space.

name: Milo
description: Blue-eyed kitten who attacks shoelaces. Litter trained and fine with other cats.

name: Sandy
description: Beach dog. Will fetch a stick from the sea all afternoon and then sleep in the car.

name: Kiwi
description: Green parakeet with a red patch above the beak. Whistles a short tune and says a few words. Went missing near the central park.

name: Daisy
description: Corgi puppy with enormous ears. Friendly with everyone, needs daily walks.

name: Oreo
description: Talkative and social. Follows you from room to room and comments on everything.

name: Biscuit
description: Brindle face with a crooked grin and a missing front tooth. Wears a dark collar. Slipped out of the gate in Mirpur.

name: Snow
description: Thick white coat, mellow temperament. Loves cool tiled floors and being talked to.

name: Shiro
description: Independent and tidy. Prefers a quiet home and a routine.

name: Casper
description: Cream-coloured and endlessly patient. Sits for photos like he has done it before.

name: Jack
description: Small, fast and fearless. Digs. Best with an owner who enjoys long runs.

name: Sunny
description: Catches anything thrown, including things nobody threw.

name: Sausage
description: Red dachshund with a pink tongue that is always out. Answers to Sausage, mostly. Last seen near the Khulna rail station.

name: Pixie
description: Tiny, loud and sure she is a big dog. Travels in a tote bag.

name: Rocky
description: Big grin, bigger heart. Needs training and an owner who is firm and kind.

name: Mochi
description: Lap dog with feathered ears. Happiest being stroked.

name: Honey
description: Waggy, bouncy and house-trained. Loves water.

name: Pugsley
description: Snores. Sulks when dinner is late. Forgives instantly.

name: Zoom
description: Retired racer. Sprints for ten seconds, then lies on his back for ten hours.

name: Desi
description: Rescued from the roadside, now healthy and vaccinated. Lean, alert and very street-smart.

name: Shadow
description: Watches the street from the windowsill all day. Yellow eyes, soft purr.

name: Smokey
description: Green-eyed and playful. Likes to be upside down for no reason.

name: Ginger
description: Squints at you like he knows something. Loves a warm lap.

name: Leo
description: Long fur, long whiskers, a small bell on his collar.

name: Tiger
description: Sits upright and waits to be admired. Easy to live with.

name: Pixel
description: Sleeps on the keyboard. Has deleted at least one assignment.

name: Kalo
description: Sleek black cat with copper eyes. Quiet, affectionate, clean.

name: Mimi
description: Orange, black and white patches with a white chest. Very vocal. Went missing near GEC Circle.

name: Ash
description: Round-faced kitten with a stealthy crawl.

name: Duchess
description: A large, magnificent tail and the attitude to match.

name: Yoda
description: Curly grey fur and a permanent look of mild disapproval.

name: Boo
description: Folded ears, round amber eyes, alarmed by everything and then fine.

name: Nimbu
description: Small orange kitten who looks straight up at you when she wants food.

name: Pudding
description: Short legs, big eyes, enormous toe beans.

name: Cloud
description: Closes his eyes whenever he is happy, which is often.

name: Bhola
description: Rolls in grass, then looks surprised about it.

name: Gizmo
description: Sticks his tongue out when he is thinking.

name: Pesto
description: Green-cheeked conure. Climbs, chews and whispers.

name: Rio
description: Flies free in the garden every evening and comes back when whistled.

name: Ruby
description: Loud, social and bright. Needs a large aviary and a lot of company.

name: Jaco
description: Speaks in full sentences and does the doorbell. Very clever.

name: Sky
description: Striped white face, powerful beak, gentle with people she knows.

name: Mango
description: Happy to sit on a finger through a whole family dinner.
